title: Example: drop raw material here
note: This is the Inbox. Drop anything here and the studio turns it into posts: a new song link, a photo/video from a show, a lyric you want to tease, a news moment, or a one-line idea. Set kind to one of: song_release | live_clip | photo_drop | lyric_tease | story_idea | news_moment | idea. Add channels (e.g. ["tiktok","instagram"]) to steer it. Add source_url if there's a link. The studio reads status:New items and writes drafts, then flips this to 'Turned into posts'.
